scenario: LCON.2.6.1 integer determinism — bitwise mask + shift compose. `(0xF0 >> 4) & 0x0F` is 0x0F (15): right-shift a positive byte then mask the low nibble (LEXP.7.7). Guard `((t.x >> 4) & 15) == 15` gates the emit; fact_count 2 confirms.
rules_ds:
schema T scope logical:
    x: Int key

schema Hit scope logical:
    d: Int key

rule r:
    T t where ((t.x >> 4) & 15) == 15
->
    emit Hit logical d: 0
